AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist- II (Medical) Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist- II (Medical) post under the ICMR funded project titled "To develop a novel storage medium to enhance the viability of periodontal ligament fibroblasts for enabling autologous reimplantation of avulsed permanent teeth" in the Division of Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics, Centre for Dental Education and Research, AIIMS Delhi.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist- II (Medical) Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: 1. MBBS / BVSc / BDS with three years’ experience 2. MBBS / BVSc / BDS with MPH / PhD 3. MBBS / BVSc / BDS + Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. Desirable: MDS in Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics Knowledge: Knowledge of maintaining patient records, documentation and tooth extraction.

content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 80,000 per month plus 30% HRA as admissible under the ICMR funded project.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist- II (Medical) Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the screening of detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates. Only candidates with Full Name, Date of Birth, Education Qualification, Experience, Publication, etc., in their detailed CV will be considered for the screening process. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified via email regarding the date and time of the interview. The interview will be conducted via a zoom link provided to shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist- II (Medical)
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) including Full Name, Date of Birth, Education Qualification, Experience, Publication, etc. Merge your CV and documents into a single PDF file. Mention "Application for the post of Project Research Scientist - II (Medical)" and the post name and project code clearly in the subject line of the email. Send the email to the official address [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the email address on or before 15 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.
